nativeQt.snippetPolicy: No HTML/CSS replicas: native Qt components are described and linked to source. Native desktop is recorded here because the panel platform schema does not represent it.

adjust.persistence: Independent per-photo and per-band settings; old sessions use neutral defaults.
adjust.autoAdjust: Updates Exposure, Contrast, Highlights, Shadows, Saturation, and Warmth; preserves other tuning.
adjust.rendering: Lightweight photographic approximations shared by preview and export; float work uses strips, spatial filters also use full-size byte images. No added dependencies or Adobe RAW processing. Per-pixel grain and noise reduction differ with preview downsampling; inspect export at 100%.
adjust.vignette: Negative values darken corners; positive values lighten corners.

narrative.overview:
Archive is the user-approved production direction: a monochrome native photo workspace matched to Chrome City Linux. Dark gray panels, a darker canvas, silver text, and restrained native controls keep the photograph dominant. The implementation uses PySide6 Qt Widgets with Fusion styling and the system sans-serif family.

This record describes the implemented desktop interface, including its working menus and editing controls. Source authority is `gr_studio/theme.py`, `widgets.py`, `window.py`, `tuning_panel.py`, `tuning.py`, `frame_panel.py`, `geometry_panel.py`, and `import_dialog.py`. macOS has not been visually validated.

rules.name: Monochrome Interface
rules.body: Keep interface actions, selection, focus, and geometry guides neutral; image content and paper treatments may carry color.

rules.name: Persistent Export
rules.body: Keep the export action outside the inspector scroll area.

dos: **Do** preserve the large, aspect-correct preview and persistent export action.
**Do** use existing native controls, visible focus, and disabled states.
**Do** keep section defaults and conditional control visibility aligned with the implementation.
**Do** keep paper colors within the frame treatment.
**Do** describe the histogram as source luminance.
donts: **Don't** add unsupported mock controls, dependencies, or web/mobile breakpoints.
**Don't** introduce colored interface accents, heavy shadows, or decorative animation.
**Don't** add static helper subtext where tooltips or operational status already provide guidance.
**Don't** claim macOS visual validation without inspecting it there.
